The '''Aris Sector task force'''<ref name="Riders" /> was a formation of four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vanko]]'s [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The ships comprising the task force was the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Dauntless'']], and the [[Invincible (Star Destroyer)|''Invincible'']], [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] and [[Triumphant (Star Destroyer)|''Triumphant'']].<ref name="DauntlessSWE" />
